== Missing data ==
* Decipher's own Majordomo and Mailman archives of the game lists were members-only; none of their content was captured.
* No mirrors found for swccg-marketplace, stccg-discussion or decipher-announce; nothing on mail-archive.com.
* ArchiveTeam Yahoo Groups item yahoo-groups-2015-10-23T05-57-19Z-fge8fk (matches swccg-discussion) is access-restricted.
* The full dagent-intl mbox (about 6 MB) was not captured; monthly text files for September and October 2004 survive.

== Possibly faulty data ==
* Table end dates are the last Wayback capture of each list page; Decipher did not publish closing dates.

== Build notes ==
* The eGroups mirror subscribed to the Decipher list as a "remote list"; 359 eGroups and 69 Yahoo! Groups message pages were recovered (428 unique messages). E-mail addresses were removed from the text file.
